data.name: Ivilyn Kingdoms
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Overview:

In Ivilyn Kingdoms, you are not a crowned king, but a pioneer forging a new destiny in untamed lands. Lead your small group of settlers, tired of the oppression of the central kingdoms, and raise a settlement from the dust. Every felled tree, every quarried stone, and every life saved will shape your legacy. You will face not only famine and beasts, but also the moral and political dilemmas that define a true leader.

Design:

Ivilyn is a living land. The cycle of day and night brings both opportunities and dangers. Natural disasters and random events will test your ability to adapt, while your population grows, marries, and raises families. Your decisions in event cards are not mere choices; they can start wars, forge alliances, or awaken ancient horrors. Manage resources like wood, stone, food, faith, and gold, and invest the souls of your enemies in the Altar of Souls to unlock new technologies and bonuses that define your kingdom's style.

Key Features:

  • Leadership with Depth: Develop your leader with RPG attributes (Strength, Eloquence, Intelligence) that unlock new options in events and shape your way of ruling.

  • Reactive Narrative: Face hundreds of dynamic events, from noble disputes and heretical cults to dragons and demonic invasions, where your choices have a real and lasting impact on your kingdom.

  • Races with Identity: Choose from 8 unique races, such as the resilient Norse, the cunning Meowhotep, or the wise Elves, each with distinct bonuses, units, and advantages that ensure high replayability.

  • Tactical Combat: Position your troops on a battle grid. Train soldiers, archers, knights, and healers, build catapults, and use formations to overcome challenging enemies and colossal bosses.

  • Integrated Online World: Your kingdom exists in a persistent world. Invade other players to plunder resources, invite friends to help you in cooperative battles, and interact with other leaders through gifts and messages.

  • Expansive Skill Tree: Use the Souls collected in battle to unlock dozens of skills at the Altar of Souls, specializing your kingdom in military might, economic efficiency, arcane mastery, and much more.

  • A Living Kingdom: Watch your citizens work, build, patrol, and live their lives. Each inhabitant has a name, a family, and a story, making your kingdom truly yours.

data.short_description: A fantasy kingdom builder with tactical combat and survival elements. Lead settlers, make event-driven decisions that shape your story, and train armies to fight for survival or raid other players online. Every choice defines your legacy in a wild and unforgiving land.
data.supported_languages:
English, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil*, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows 7/8/8.1/10 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9 / OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • OS *: Microsoft Windows 7/8/8.1/10 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or better

  • Graphics: DirectX 9 / OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
